2428-an-essay-on-man-moral-essays-and-sa.title: Moral Essays And Satires
2428-an-essay-on-man-moral-essays-and-sa.creator: Alexander Pope.
2428-an-essay-on-man-moral-essays-and-sa.description: A book by Alexander Pope.. in his mirror, had spread another form of scepticism. The intellectual scepticism, based upon an honest search for truth, could end only in making truth the surer by its questionings. The other form of scepticism, which might be traced in England from the low-minded frivolities of the court of Charles the Second, was widely spread among the weak, whose minds flinched from all earnest thought.

33357-reminiscences-of-the-thirty-fourth.title: Reminiscences Of The Thirty Fourth Regiment Mass Vol Infantr
33357-reminiscences-of-the-thirty-fourth.creator: Unknown
33357-reminiscences-of-the-thirty-fourth.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is delivered with fitting words, and now not only the soldier, but the orator speaks. Never, while memory lasts, will the picture be erased from the mind of one, at least; the central figure, the devoted Wells: so soon, comparatively, to be the lamented.

37995-the-diamond-fairy-book.title: The Diamond Fairy Book
37995-the-diamond-fairy-book.creator: Unknown
37995-the-diamond-fairy-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. THERE were the four Kings: the King of the North, the region of perpetual snow; the King of the South, where the sun shines all the year round; the King of the East, from whence the cold winds blow; and the King of the West, where the gentle zephyrs breathe upon the flowers, and coax them to open their petals while the rest of the world is still sleeping.

arxiv-2009-11142.title: The Scheduling Job-Set Optimization Problem: A Model-based Diagnosis Approach Thanks: This work was accepted for presentation at the 31st International Workshop on Principles of Diagnosis (DX-2020) . A version of this paper presenting a more sophisticated algorithm as well as an extended evaluation
arxiv-2009-11142.creator: Patrick Rodler, Erich Teppan
arxiv-2009-11142.description: Abstract A common issue for companies is that the volume of product orders may at times exceed the production capacity. We formally introduce two novel problems dealing with the question which orders to discard or postpone in order to meet certain (timeliness) goals, and try to approach them by means of model-based diagnosis.

arxiv-2107-06534.title: Zeroth and First Order Stochastic Frank-Wolfe Algorithms for Constrained Optimization
arxiv-2107-06534.creator: Zeeshan Akhtar, and Ketan Rajawat
arxiv-2107-06534.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zeeshan Akhtar, and Ketan Rajawat. This paper considers stochastic convex optimization problems with two sets of constraints: (a) deterministic constraints on the domain of the optimization variable, which are difficult to project onto; and (b) deterministic or stochastic constraints that admit efficient projection. Problems of this form arise frequently in the context of semidefinite programming as well as when various NP-hard problems are solved approximately via semidefinite relaxation.

arxiv-2110-12005.title: Reentrant phase transitions in Einstein-Maxwell-scalar black holes
arxiv-2110-12005.creator: Dumitru Astefanesei, Paulina Cabrera, Robert B. Mann, Raúl Rojas
arxiv-2110-12005.description: Abstract We consider how scalar fields affect the thermodynamic behavior of charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes. We specifically investigate a class of (3+1)-dimensional exact hairy charged AdS black hole solutions to Einstein-Maxwell-scalar gravity, whose stable ground state and finite horizon area in the zero temperature limit make it of particular interest.

arxiv-2210-10880.title: Learning To Invert: Simple Adaptive Attacks for Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning
arxiv-2210-10880.creator: Ruihan Wu, Xiangyu Chen, Chuan Guo, Kilian Q. Weinberger
arxiv-2210-10880.description: Abstract Gradient inversion attack enables the recovery of training samples from model gradients in federated learning (FL), and constitutes a serious threat to data privacy. To mitigate this vulnerability, prior work proposed both principled defenses based on differential privacy, as well as heuristic defenses based on gradient compression as countermeasures.

arxiv-2211-13105.title: Existence results for a nonlinear nonautonomus transmission problem via domain perturbation
arxiv-2211-13105.creator: Matteo Dalla Riva, Riccardo Molinarolo, Paolo Musolino
arxiv-2211-13105.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper we study the existence and the analytic dependence upon domain perturbation of the solutions of a nonlinear nonautonomous transmission problem for the Laplace equation. The problem is defined in a pair of sets consisting of a perforated domain and an inclusion whose shape is determined by a suitable diffeomorphism \phi .

arxiv-2310-07306.title: SNOiC: Soft Labeling and Noisy Mixup based Open Intent Classification Model
arxiv-2310-07306.creator: Aditi Kanwar, Aditi Seetha, Satyendra Singh Chouhan, Rajdeep Niyogi
arxiv-2310-07306.description: Abstract This paper presents a Soft Labeling and Noisy Mixup-based open intent classification model (SNOiC). Most of the previous works have used threshold-based methods to identify open intents, which are prone to overfitting and may produce biased predictions. Additionally, the need for more available data for an open intent class presents another limitation for these existing models.

arxiv-2402-18959.title: MambaStock: Selective state space model for stock prediction
arxiv-2402-18959.creator: Zhuangwei Shi
arxiv-2402-18959.description: Abstract The stock market plays a pivotal role in economic development, yet its intricate volatility poses challenges for investors. Consequently, research and accurate predictions of stock price movements are crucial for mitigating risks. Traditional time series models fall short in capturing nonlinearity, leading to unsatisfactory stock predictions.

arxiv-2403-18011.title: On AdS 4 deformations of celestial symmetries
arxiv-2403-18011.creator: and David Skinner
arxiv-2403-18011.description: Abstract Celestial holography has led to the discovery of new symmetry algebras arising from the study of collinear limits of perturbative gravity amplitudes in flat space. We explain from the twistor perspective how a non-vanishing cosmological constant Λ \Lambda naturally modifies the celestial chiral algebra.

arxiv-2409-16103.title: Electric field management in β \beta – Ga 2 O 3 vertical Schottky diodes using high-k bismuth zinc niobium oxide
arxiv-2409-16103.creator: Pooja Sharma*, Yeshwanth Parasubotu, Saurabh Lodha
arxiv-2409-16103.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pooja Sharma*, Yeshwanth Parasubotu, Saurabh Lodha. In this work, we have integrated bismuth zinc niobium oxide (BZN), a high-k dielectric material, in metal-insulator-semiconductor (MIS) and field-plated metal-semiconductor (FP-MS) Schottky barrier diodes on β \beta -Ga 2 O 3 . This increases the breakdown voltage ( V B ​ R V_{BR} ) from 300 V to 600 V by redistributing the electric fields, leveraging the high permittivity of BZN (k ∼ \sim 210).

arxiv-2508-13904.title: Revisiting Diffusion Q-Learning: From Iterative Denoising to One-Step Action Generation
arxiv-2508-13904.creator: Thanh Nguyen, Chang D. Yoo
arxiv-2508-13904.description: Abstract The generative power of diffusion models (DMs) has recently enabled high-performing decision-making algorithms in offline reinforcement learning (RL), achieving state-of-the-art results across standard benchmarks. Among them, Diffusion Q-Learning (DQL) stands out as a leading method for its consistently strong performance.

arxiv-2509-19459.title: Automated Insertion of Flushes and Fences for Persistency
arxiv-2509-19459.creator: Yutong Guo, Weiyu Luo, Brian Demsky
arxiv-2509-19459.description: Abstract CXL shared memory and persistent memory allow the contents of memory to persist beyond crashes. Stores to persistent or CXL memory are typically not immediately made persistent; developers must manually flush the corresponding cache lines to force the data to be written to the underlying storage. Correctly using flush and fence operations is known to be challenging.

arxiv-2603-03318.creator: Nikita Kuznetsov, Niyaz Ismagilov, Ernesto Campos

europmc-pmc11093732.creator: Pachitariu M, Sridhar S, Pennington J, Stringer C.
europmc-pmc11093732.description: Spike sorting is the computational process of extracting the firing times of single neurons from recordings of local electrical fields. This is an important but hard problem in neuroscience, made complicated by the nonstationarity of the recordings and the dense overlap in...

pmc-10749947.title: Markers and mechanisms of death in Drosophila
pmc-10749947.creator: John Tower
pmc-10749947.description: Parameters correlated with age and mortality in Drosophila melanogaster include decreased negative geotaxis and centrophobism behaviors, decreased climbing and walking speed, and darkened pigments in oenocytes and eye. Cessation of egg laying predicts death within approximately 5 days. Endogenous green fluorescence in eye and body increases hours prior to death.

pmc-11435391.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Experimental Study of the Mechanical and Tribological Properties of GNS-COOH/PEEK/PTFE Composites
pmc-11435391.creator: Zhen Dong, Henan Tang, Bin Yang, Shijie Wang, Yunlong Li, Lin Liu, Alexander Malkin
pmc-11435391.description: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were first employed to achieve the optimal sintering temperature of carboxyl-functionalized graphene (GNS-COOH)-modified polyether ether ketone (PEEK)/polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) composites. A model of GNS-COOH/PEEK/PTFE composites was constructed to simulate the effects of different sintering temperatures on the mechanical and tribological properties, as well as their underlying atomic mechanisms.

pmc-11494552.title: Bibliometric and knowledge map analysis of one lung ventilation
pmc-11494552.creator: Zhipeng Zhong, Yantong Wan, Zishi Lin, Junyong Chen, Jing Ye
pmc-11494552.description: BackgroundOne lung ventilation (OLV) is an essential method of lung isolation to protect the ventilated lung from soiling by the contralateral lung and obtain optimal surgical exposure in thoracic surgery. This study aims to examine the trends and developments in OLV research from 1982 to 2024 through bibliometric analysis.

pmc-11532476.title: VCP enhances autophagy-related osteosarcoma progression by recruiting USP2 to inhibit ubiquitination and degradation of FASN
pmc-11532476.creator: Shijiang Wang, Jiangbo Nie, Haoxin Jiang, Anan Li, Nanshan Zhong, Weilai Tong, Geliang Yao, Alan Jiang, Xinsheng Xie, Yanxin Zhong, Zhiguo Shu, Jiaming Liu, Feng Yang, Zhili Liu
pmc-11532476.description: Osteosarcoma (OS) is a highly aggressive malignant tumor with a high rate of disability and mortality rates, and dysregulated autophagy is a crucial factor in cancer. However, the molecular mechanisms that regulate autophagy in OS remain unclear. This study aimed to explore key molecules that affect autophagy in OS and their regulatory mechanisms.

pmc-11546761.title: Serum Lipoprotein Profiling by NMR Spectroscopy Reveals Alterations in HDL-1 and HDL-2 Apo-A2 Subfractions in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-11546761.creator: Jonas Ellegaard Mortensen, Trygve Andreassen, Dorte Aalund Olsen, Karsten Vestergaard, Jonna Skov Madsen, Søren Risom Kristensen, Shona Pedersen
pmc-11546761.description: Identifying biomarkers for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is crucial, due to its complex pathology, which involves dysfunction in lipid transport, contributing to neuroinflammation, synaptic loss, and impaired amyloid-β clearance. Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) is able to quantify and stratify lipoproteins. The study investigated lipoproteins in blood from AD patients, aiming to evaluate their diagnostic potential.

pmc-11639906.title: The Effects of Animal, Collection Time, and Interval on the Microbiota Structure, Metabolism, and Degradative Potential of Rumen Fluid Inoculum Collected by Esophageal Probe from Hay-Fed Cows
pmc-11639906.creator: Marica Simoni, Alexandros Mavrommatis, Andrea Cresceri, Marco Severgnini, Mauro Penasa, Matteo Santinello, Bianca Castiglioni, Paola Cremonesi, Eleni Tsiplakou, Federico Righi
pmc-11639906.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryIn vitro digestibility tests are essential for the evaluation of the nutritional value of forages and feeds but they need rumen fluid collected from animals as inoculum to be performed. However, it is well known that the degradative capacity of the rumen fluid can fluctuate depending on the animal and the time of collection, probably as a function of the rumen microbes’ populations. The enzymatic activity expressed by the microbes is expected to represent the rumen fluid’s degradative potential.

pmc-12749695.title: Spectral peak picking improves tactile speech perception
pmc-12749695.creator: Mark D. Fletcher, Carl A. Verschuur, Esma Akis
pmc-12749695.description: Individual differences in speech perception often arise from disparities in access to acoustic–phonetic cues, particularly among those with hearing loss. Haptic hearing aids, which convey speech information through the sense of touch, offer a complementary pathway to improve speech understanding. However, effectively transmitting critical speech features through vibrotactile stimulation remains challenging.

pmc-13378966.title: Glycaemic, cardiorenal, and lipid parameters associated with SGLT2 inhibitors use in Indonesian patients with type 2 diabetes: 12-month multicenter real-world study
pmc-13378966.creator: Fonny Cokro, Rani Sauriasari, Dicky Levenus Tahapary, Heri Setiawan, Christian Tricaesario, Nurul Hidayati, William Djauhari, Jimmy Tandradynata, Sidartawan Soegondo
pmc-13378966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) have demonstrated efficacy in glycaemic control and cardiorenal protection across multiple meta-analyses. However, their applicability to the Indonesian population remains uncertain due to demographic, lifestyle, and healthcare disparities.

pmc-13657889.title: Sustained remission of NELL-1-positive membranous nephropathy after lung adenocarcinoma resection and during subsequent atezolizumab therapy in a 68-year-old man: a case report
pmc-13657889.creator: Masafumi Ikezawa, Yasuyuki Ikezawa, Mina Eguchi, Fumihiko Hattanda, Akihiro Yokoyama, Tetsuaki Shoji, Makoto Araki, Mitsuru Yanai, Yayoi Ogawa, Jun Sakakibara-Konishi, Satoshi Konno
pmc-13657889.description: BackgroundMembranous nephropathy (MN) is a leading cause of nephrotic syndrome in adults and may occur secondary to malignancy, with lung cancer representing one of the most frequently associated malignancies. Neural epidermal growth factor-like 1 (NELL-1), identified as a target antigen in MN in 2019, has been associated with malignancy, although reported frequencies vary across cohorts.

uslaw-usc-t41-s4705.title: 41 U.S.C. § 4705 — Protection of contractor employees from reprisal for disclosure of certain information
uslaw-usc-t41-s4705.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t41-s4705.description: United States Code, Title 41 (Public Contracts); Chapter 47 (Miscellaneous). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions.— In this section: (1) Contract.— The term “contract” means a contract awarded by the head of an executive agency. (2) Contractor.— The term “contractor” means a person awarded a contract with an executive agency. (3) Inspector general.— The term “Inspector General” means an Inspector General.
